explanation: Nearly always 9-10: GO is 10 and D2 is 10 when the agent chose a2 or the transition was rare, 9 (sometimes 8) after a1 reached S1; D1 is about 9 after a rewarded trial or any a2 trial. It drops only at D1 while the agent has been choosing a1, after an unrewarded trial: about 6-8 if that trial went common to S1, 0-3 if it went rare to S2 (and occasionally 0-3 after a rare a1-to-S2 trial even if rewarded), with the deepest drops late in the episode (trial 70 and after).
